gloss: one song; one piece of music

definitions.explanation: {一|いち} plus the counter {曲|きょく} (pieces of music). Used for a single song or instrumental piece in a performance, on a program, or on a recording.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{一曲|いっきょく}⟦{歌|うた}って→歌う：00684_utau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦アンコール→アンコール：05928_ankooru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{一曲|いっきょく}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}した→演奏する：20349_ensousuru⟧。
examples.english: They played just one song for the encore.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{一曲|いっきょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: I hear it took them more than six months to finish this one song.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{一曲|いっきょく}: one more song
- {一曲|いっきょく}⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧: to sing a song
- {一曲|いっきょく}⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: the first song (on a program or setlist)
- {一曲|いっきょく}⟦{丸|まる}ごと→丸ごと：10545_marugoto⟧: a whole song, all the way through

COUNTING PATTERNS:
The counter ⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧ continues {二曲|にきょく}, {三曲|さんきょく}, {四曲|よんきょく}, {五曲|ごきょく}, {何曲|なんきょく} (how many songs). Note the sound change in {一曲|いっきょく} and {六曲|ろっきょく}.
